evidence.observation: La partie basse de l'escalier et son parapet sont visibles; sa projection exacte reste seulement bornee grossierement.
La vue arriere confirme une volee basse qui rejoint un changement de direction avant l'arrivee au palier.
Le raccord superieur est visible au voisinage du volume/palier massif, sans preuve d'une coordonnee exacte du coude.
La volee superieure rejoint le palier et n'est pas collineaire a la volee basse.

stair_system_links.statement: Metric lower run is a low-confidence Scene segmentation of the one Survey stair system.
Metric upper run is a low-confidence Scene segmentation of the one Survey stair system.

relation_updates.statement: La volee superieure inferee rejoint physiquement le palier massif; l'identite semantique de l'escalier reste stair-exterior-1 via les liens de provenance.

inference_notes: Owner-confirmed Survey topology fixes the qualitative route: descent from platform-massive-1 goes west beyond the main rear plane, turns left, then goes south to the low courtyard; ascent is the reverse. This topology is user-provided, but the coordinates remain Scene inference.

No new stair dimension is introduced: the existing provisional 1.0 m width, 1.15 m intermediate rise split, 2.3 m total rise, and horizontal run-length magnitudes 2.5 m and 0.9 m are retained and only reoriented/repositioned to realize the confirmed route.

The upper platform contact uses the existing platform-massive-1 rear boundary y=7.8 and the previously inferred x=-2.0 contact coordinate; the resulting turn coordinate and west overrun are derived provisional placement, not owner measurements.
Exact run lengths, exact west overrun, exact turn coordinate, tread count, and landing dimensions remain unresolved.
